name: 113.1 — the state the server sent, as the bytes it sent
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 113.1: gob:sdt() answers a dense 1-based 0..255 array for a resource-drawn gob, nil for one that is gone or whose body is composed, matches gob:info().sdt element for element and survives a hafen.json round trip, and gob:sdt(1) raises naming arity.
